잠언 7:1.content: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.

잠언 7:2.content: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.

잠언 7:3.content: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.

잠언 7:4.content: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:

잠언 7:5.content: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.

잠언 7:6.content: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,

잠언 7:7.content: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,

잠언 7:8.content: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,

잠언 7:9.content: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:

잠언 7:10.content: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.

잠언 7:11.content: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:

잠언 7:12.content: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)

잠언 7:13.content: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,

잠언 7:14.content: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.

잠언 7:15.content: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.

잠언 7:16.content: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.

잠언 7:17.content: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

잠언 7:18.content: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.

잠언 7:19.content: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:

잠언 7:20.content: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.

잠언 7:21.content: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.

잠언 7:22.content: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;

잠언 7:23.content: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.

잠언 7:24.content: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.

잠언 7:25.content: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.

잠언 7:26.content: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.

잠언 7:27.content: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
